markdown: **Activate—Rattle the Dead** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Blowing into the horn frightens ghosts and evil spirits who can hear its call. Make an Intimidation check to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53) against all creatures with the undead or unholy trait in a 30-foot emanation. This can affect even a mindless creature with that trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language.
